Exact quadratic invariance defect B=a²(d+1)/2 and transverse O(y) derivatives give e_n=O(y_n³); cubic scalar coefficient -a²d(d+3)/8. Inverting yields a positive linear clock and a universal log coefficient 3a(d+1)/4, with O(log n/n²) summable increments. The standalone check.py passed exact SymPy coefficients and two finite trajectory diagnostics, which were not treated as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2024 article (equations (1.7), (3.4)–(3.5), Theorem 3.1, pp.33–39) proves the neutral transcritical bifurcation and computes the quadratic slaving and center-manifold terms, which are expressly credited. The new claim is the cubic scalar coefficient, summable remainder and finite reciprocal clock with precise positive log coefficient over an invariant positive-data wedge. Targeted published-finding corpus and web searches did not retrieve a stronger same-map result. This is best-knowledge rather than a proof of bibliographic uniqueness.

value.rationale: The predator invasion threshold b=d is a natural nonhyperbolic boundary of a published biological recurrence. Exact extinction timing over growing generations requires the first model-specific correction beyond the known quadratic transcritical normal form; it distinguishes a finite time-shift invariant from a mere n^-1 bound, with a universally positive logarithmic delay and a proved nonempty open basin wedge. It is a substantive quantitative boundary result, not an arbitrary parameter slice or finite diagnostic.
